subject: measured_on.living_stamp
what_was_wrong: The living board stamp was presented as a checkable attestation. It is not. It shipped signed:true and a sig_input sentence, the same shape as the two attestations on this site that do verify. No published bytes reproduce it.
how_caught: Outside audit of the live site, 2026-08-26. Re-run the same day: both published signatures, all five published keys, nine candidate payloads, raw/digest/hex forms, both ensure_ascii settings, every drop-set of up to three fields.
faults: Two signatures for one stamp: 53aa09fa… in /signed/board_living.json and bd199fd3… on /api/gspc measured_on.living_stamp (same signer, same updated). At most one can be over the bytes the other is over.
Signer 8f9a00a2… is in none of the verification methods in https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json, so a reproducing preimage would still only prove self-consistency.
board_living.json states its axes were re-snapshotted from the live board six days after the signature date, so the signed bytes are not the published bytes.
what_this_does_not_claim: The stamp is not asserted INVALID. It is asserted UNCHECKABLE, which for a relying party is the same outcome. Bytes are not withdrawn. A quietly deleted stamp would be worse than a public UNVERIFIABLE row.
close_requires: Publish one preimage rule: which fields are signature fields; raw bytes vs digest vs hex; ensure_ascii; number encoding.
Publish ONE signature over those exact bytes.
Anchor the signer in did.json, or re-sign with a published key.
Owner holds the key. This note does not mint one.
do_not: Fill the 7 UNMEASURED slots to make the stamp look live.
Treat site_attestation on /api/gspc as substantiating this stamp. It covers integrity of the payload as served.
Launch a ticker. XRP/ETH/RWA are subjects to measure, not products to float.
ledger_signature_note: GET /api/corrections currently serves signature_state STALE: the array was appended after the 2026-08-22 re-issue. A stale signature is a published defect, never a silent edit. Re-issue is owner-gated.
unsigned_reason: This note records that a stamp cannot be checked. Signing the note with another key would not make the stamp verifiable. Owner may later sign this file under #card-attestation-1; until then it is unsigned on purpose.
